Regulus.glory: Power, military honors, worldly success, political preferment
Regulus.nemesis: Revenge - if the native seeks retribution, everything is lost

Aldebaran.glory: Merchant King, military commander, success through innovation
Aldebaran.nemesis: Integrity - dishonesty leads to complete downfall

Antares.glory: Intensity, passion, success through sheer force of will
Antares.nemesis: Obsession - burning out through excessive intensity

Fomalhaut.glory: Sublime, artistic, mystical success, fame through idealism
Fomalhaut.nemesis: Corruption - using spiritual gifts for material gain

Algol.delineation: The most evil star in the heavens. Danger of losing one's head, either literally or figuratively. Violence, decapitation, murder. On the Hyleg, threatens violent death.

Spica.delineation: The most fortunate star. Boundless good fortune, riches that do not corrupt, success in art and science. Protection from violence.

Vindemiatrix.delineation: The Widow-maker. Danger to the spouse, widowhood, falsity, disgrace.

Caput Algol.delineation: See Algol. The Demon's Head. Pile-up of misfortune.

Scheat.delineation: Danger by water, shipwreck, drowning, imprisonment. Extreme misfortune.

Betelgeuse.delineation: Martial honors, preferment, wealth. Quick gains that may not last.

Rigel.delineation: Great wealth, splendor, renown, good fortune without nemesis.

Procyon.delineation: Quick rise but also quick fall. Petulance, violence, sudden success.

Sirius.delineation: The Dog Star. High office, fame, honors, but danger from great dogs or wolves.

Pollux.delineation: Subtle, crafty, spirited, audacious. Danger of disgrace and ruin.

Castor.delineation: Intellectual, writes well, subject to sudden fame or notoriety.
